relationship_notes: Independent analog pedal project run by Adrian Gutierrez R. in the Dominican Republic. Builder self-identifies a 2020 start and describes work reviving and experimenting with overdrive, fuzz, Velcro fuzz and bass-fuzz circuits. Effects Database added AGR Pedals as a new brand in January 2026 and documents four models; the builder's December 2025 submission also names Mid Booster. Preserve individual circuit families and any later revisions as specimen/generation states rather than duplicate builders.
